name: Gradaly v4.5.0
title: Gradaly v4.5.0
notes:
### 🌍 10-Language Support, Native Cloud Demo Projects & Unicode/CJK PDF Engine
- **10-Language Support Across Gradaly**: Full localization of the Desktop interface, AI grading & rubric assistant prompts, student & teacher web portals, Excel/Word/CSV/Moodle exports, and offline OCR matching in **French, English, Dutch, German, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean**.
- **Native Cloud Demo Projects in All 10 Languages**: Creating an Exam or QR Practice demo project now automatically fetches a 100% natively localized demo (canvas, 20 handwritten student copies, roster, rubric, and AI feedbacks) matching your active language, with local caching and seamless offline fallback while reducing installer size by ~4 MB.
- **Cross-Platform Unicode & CJK PDF Engine**: Bundled Noto Sans Unicode & CJK fonts with automatic kinsoku line wrapping and glyph fallback for zero-crash annotated PDF and QR slip generation on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
